project_info.theme: Toyota Yaris Cross Hybrid makes stopping unnecessary
project_info.color_palette: Warm yellow, coral red, deep blue, white, black

main_subject.detail: A vibrant collage poster featuring a stylish young woman in a red sweater and pleated mini skirt with a red Toyota Yaris Cross Hybrid. The poster combines multiple angled panels: one panel shows her leaning on the car, one shows her seated in the driver's area, one shows her in a top-down fashion pose beside the car, and another shows passengers smiling inside the vehicle. Large headline text reads 'SAO PHAI co "DUNG XE DI"? YARIS CROSS NANG NGAI CHI!'. Bottom offer strip lists 'UU DAI TUONG DUONG 50 TRIEU DONG', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT CHI TU 7.75%', 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG', and 'BAO HANH XE VA AC QUY DIEN HYBRID LEN DEN 10 NAM HOAC 185.000 KM (*)'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Energetic editorial collage with fashion-commercial photography, hybrid product messaging, and neon-panel framing

Background is a warm yellow gradient with diagonal collage dividers and glowing panel edges. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'SAO PHAI co "DUNG XE DI"? YARIS CROSS NANG NGAI CHI!', and the bottom offer strip with '50 TRIEU DONG', '7.75%', '0 DONG', and '10 NAM HOAC 185.000 KM'. Technical style: photoreal fashion-automotive collage poster, bright editorial-commercial lighting, glossy highlights and youth-campaign energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
